mapper.select: SELECT a.id as id, a.user_code as user_code, a.title as title, a.content as content, a.is_draft as is_draft, a.created_at as created_at, a.updated_at as updated_at, ai.id as ai_id, ai.artwork_id as artwork_id, ai.file_url as file_url, ai.file_name as file_name, ai.uploaded_at as uploaded_at FROM artworks a INNER JOIN artwork_images ai ON a.id = ai.artwork_id WHERE a.user_code = #{userCode} AND a.is_draft = TRUE
mapper.update: update artworks set is_draft = FALSE, content=#{content} where user_code= #{userCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM artworks WHERE user_code = #{userCode} AND is_draft = TRUE
